ON-CALL HANDOFF — gateway 503s, 2026-03-14

ROOT CAUSE

  Error: ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED acquiring connection from pool (size 20, in_use 20, waiting 13)
  Wait queue grew from 13 to 271. It never recovered.

  Paged   03:21:05, "error_rate 5m avg is 71%"
  Scope   all routes and all four upstreams. Log is node-3 of 3.

ROLL BACK
  dep-4471, gateway, a.novak, started 02:12:00Z, finished 02:14:00Z
  "config: connection-per-request for pool isolation"
  Revert config to generation 118. That also restores
  gateway.timeout.upstreamMs 2500 -> 2000, which is fine.
  Alternative if the pool isolation is wanted: raise pool size well past 20 first.

NOT THE CAUSE
  dep-4472 billing-svc 02:41 and dep-4473 catalog-svc 03:20 both ship after onset.
  Workers are clean. Zero errors, pool flat at size=8 in_use=1 waiting=0.

SEPARATE, LOWER PRIORITY

  db_wait stays under 12ms, so the delay is not the database.
  One WARN db at 02:36, slow query 1.9s, known issue OPS-2210.
